name: iter_vary_lr_schedule
description: 2D: per-iteration LEARNING-RATE SCHEDULE x base learning rate. In a loop the learning rate decides how far each round is allowed to move the weights, which is the optimiser-side control of the same focus-vs-forgetting tension the paper found dominant on the data side. A decaying rate should let the early rounds absorb the weak region and the late rounds consolidate; a constant rate should keep drifting. Accumulative regime, 8 iterations, one detector, 10 seeds.
